meaning.en: Barely alive; listless and lifeless.
meaning.zh: 形容不死不活的样子，也形容没精神、没生气。

examples.zh: 那盆花浇了水还是半死不活。
examples.en: Even after watering, the plant is still half-dead.

examples.zh: 他整天半死不活的，什么都不想干。
examples.en: He's listless all day and doesn't want to do anything.

meaning.en: Solemn vows of love, as lasting as the sea and mountains.
meaning.zh: 指男女相爱时立下的誓言，像山海一样永不改变。

examples.zh: 他们海誓山盟，说要相爱一生。
examples.en: They exchanged solemn vows to love each other for life.

examples.zh: 当年的海誓山盟，早已烟消云散。
examples.en: The vows of those days have long since vanished.

usage.en: Often used with a hint of irony when promises are broken.
usage.zh: 常带讽刺意味，暗指誓言落空。

meaning.en: Stinking too badly to bear.
meaning.zh: 臭得让人无法忍受。

examples.zh: 垃圾堆积如山，臭不可闻。
examples.en: The rubbish is piled high and the stench is unbearable.

examples.zh: 那条河被污染得臭不可闻。
examples.en: The river is so polluted it stinks.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，也比喻名声很坏。

meaning.en: Overcome with grief, as if one's insides were torn to pieces.
meaning.zh: 形容极度悲痛，好像内脏被扯断。

examples.zh: 听到噩耗，母亲肝肠寸断。
examples.en: On hearing the terrible news, the mother was torn apart by grief.

examples.zh: 那凄凉的曲子让人肝肠寸断。
examples.en: The mournful tune is enough to break one's heart.

meaning.en: To unify the whole country under one rule; to dominate completely.
meaning.zh: 统一全国，也比喻完全占据某一领域。

examples.zh: 秦始皇灭六国，一统天下。
examples.en: The First Emperor destroyed the six states and unified China.

examples.zh: 这家公司想在行业里一统天下。
examples.en: The company wants to dominate the whole industry.

meaning.en: To boast about oneself.
meaning.zh: 自己吹喇叭，自己打鼓，比喻自我吹嘘。

examples.zh: 他最爱自吹自擂，大家都不爱听。
examples.en: He loves to blow his own trumpet and nobody likes listening.

examples.zh: 好产品不用自吹自擂。
examples.en: A good product doesn't need to boast.

meaning.en: To cut the superfluous and keep to the simple.
meaning.zh: 去掉繁杂的部分，使之简明。

examples.zh: 写文章要删繁就简，突出重点。
examples.en: When writing, cut the clutter and highlight the main points.

examples.zh: 流程需要删繁就简。
examples.en: The process needs to be streamlined.

meaning.en: Especially charming and beautiful.
meaning.zh: 格外娇艳美丽。

examples.zh: 雪后的山川分外妖娆。
examples.en: The mountains and rivers after snow are especially enchanting.

examples.zh: 夜幕下的江景分外妖娆。
examples.en: The river view at night is strikingly beautiful.

story.en: Mao Zedong's ci poem 'Snow': 'On a clear day, see the land in red and white — especially enchanting' (须晴日，看红装素裹，分外妖娆).
story.zh: 毛泽东《沁园春·雪》：“须晴日，看红装素裹，分外妖娆。”

natural: in the blink of an eye

meaning.en: In an instant.
meaning.zh: 形容时间极短。

equivalents: in the blink of an eye

examples.zh: 转眼之间，孩子已经长大成人。
examples.en: In the blink of an eye, the child has grown up.

examples.zh: 转眼之间，一年过去了。
examples.en: Before we knew it, a year had gone by.

meaning.en: To shelve or cast aside a person or thing.
meaning.zh: 比喻把人或事物搁置一旁，不予理会。

examples.zh: 那个方案被领导打入冷宫。
examples.en: The proposal was shelved by the boss.

examples.zh: 他失势后，被打入冷宫。
examples.en: After losing favour, he was cast aside.

meaning.en: Inseparably close, like a couple deeply in love.
meaning.zh: 像胶和漆一样黏合，形容感情深厚，难舍难分。

equivalents: stuck to each other like glue

examples.zh: 这对新婚夫妇如胶似漆。
examples.en: The newly-weds are inseparable.

examples.zh: 他们热恋时如胶似漆。
examples.en: When they were in love, they were stuck to each other like glue.

natural: people from all walks of life

meaning.en: Religions and schools of thought; people of every type, sometimes dubious.
meaning.zh: 旧指儒、释、道三教和各种学术流派，也泛指社会上各行各业的人。

examples.zh: 他走南闯北，三教九流的人都认识。
examples.en: Having travelled everywhere, he knows people of every sort.

examples.zh: 码头上聚集着三教九流。
examples.en: All sorts of characters gather at the docks.

meaning.en: To bare one's teeth in a fierce or pained grimace.
meaning.zh: 形容凶狠的样子，也形容疼痛难忍的样子。

examples.zh: 他疼得龇牙咧嘴。
examples.en: He grimaced with pain.

examples.zh: 那条狗对着陌生人龇牙咧嘴。
examples.en: The dog bared its teeth at the stranger.

meaning.en: Everyone rises together to attack someone.
meaning.zh: 大家一起起来攻击。

examples.zh: 他一发表这种言论，就被网友群起而攻之。
examples.en: As soon as he said that, netizens piled on him.

examples.zh: 坏人坏事应该群起而攻之。
examples.en: Wrongdoers and wrongdoing should be attacked by all.

meaning.en: People's hearts are scattered; the group has lost its cohesion.
meaning.zh: 大家的心不齐，缺乏凝聚力。

examples.zh: 连续失利后，球队人心涣散。
examples.en: After a string of defeats, team morale collapsed.

examples.zh: 领导不力，难免人心涣散。
examples.en: With weak leadership, loss of cohesion is inevitable.

meaning.en: Chaos and commotion, as if chickens and dogs were running wild.
meaning.zh: 形容混乱、吵闹的情景。

examples.zh: 孩子们一放假，家里就鸡飞狗跳。
examples.en: Once the kids are on holiday, the house is pandemonium.

examples.zh: 搬家那天，弄得鸡飞狗跳。
examples.en: Moving day turned into utter chaos.

natural: leave at dawn, arrive by dusk

meaning.en: To set out in the morning and arrive by evening; very quick travel.
meaning.zh: 早晨出发，晚上到达，形容路程近或交通便利。

equivalents: leave in the morning, arrive by evening

examples.zh: 高铁开通后，两地朝发夕至。
examples.en: Since the high-speed rail opened, the two cities are a day trip apart.

examples.zh: 现在出国也能朝发夕至。
examples.en: Even going abroad can now be done in a day.

meaning.en: Cheering so loud it rumbles like thunder.
meaning.zh: 欢呼声像雷一样响。

examples.zh: 比赛一结束，全场欢声雷动。
examples.en: As soon as the game ended, the whole stadium erupted in cheers.

examples.zh: 广场上欢声雷动。
examples.en: Cheers thundered across the square.

meaning.en: Too kind an invitation to turn down.
meaning.zh: 对方的好意太深厚，难以推辞。

examples.zh: 主人盛情难却，我们只好留下吃饭。
examples.en: Our host was too kind to refuse, so we stayed for dinner.

examples.zh: 盛情难却，我就收下了。
examples.en: I can't turn down such kindness, so I'll accept.

natural: blanch at the mention of tigers

meaning.en: To turn pale merely at the mention of something one fears.
meaning.zh: 一提到老虎就脸色大变，比喻一说到可怕的事就害怕。

equivalents: turn pale at the mere mention
be terrified at the very thought

examples.zh: 经历过那次事故，他至今谈虎色变。
examples.en: Since that accident, he blanches at the mere mention of it.

examples.zh: 很多人对癌症谈虎色变。
examples.en: Many people go pale at the very word cancer.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“对…谈虎色变”。

meaning.en: To be punished more severely; to make matters worse.
meaning.zh: 加重一级处罚，也比喻情况更糟。

examples.zh: 拒不认罪，只会罪加一等。
examples.en: Refusing to admit guilt will only make the sentence heavier.

examples.zh: 撒谎掩盖错误，罪加一等。
examples.en: Lying to cover up a mistake makes it worse.

meaning.en: The shifting warmth and coldness of people, depending on one's fortunes.
meaning.zh: 人情冷暖随人的得势或失势而变。

examples.zh: 落魄之后，他才尝到了世态炎凉。
examples.en: Only after his fall did he taste the fickleness of human nature.

examples.zh: 她看尽了世态炎凉。
examples.en: She has seen how cold and warm people can be.

usage.en: Noun phrase; often 尝尽世态炎凉.
usage.zh: 名词性，常说“尝尽世态炎凉”。

meaning.en: The joy of moving into a new home or new post.
meaning.zh: 搬到新居或升迁的喜事。

examples.zh: 恭贺老同学乔迁之喜！
examples.en: Congratulations to my old classmate on the new home!

examples.zh: 今天朋友办乔迁之喜，我去道贺。
examples.en: A friend is holding a housewarming today, so I'm going to congratulate him.

usage.en: Said as a congratulation: 恭贺乔迁之喜.
usage.zh: 多用于祝贺：“恭贺乔迁之喜”。
